reasons: Some pinned versions appear too old for the code that calls them, which is a likely cause of failures.
Development and test tools are mixed in with runtime libraries.
No tests are visible to confirm that these versions work together.

terms.meaning: A library version fixed exactly, so the same version is installed every time.
A library that the app needs in order to run.
A private folder of libraries kept separate from the rest of the computer.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Pinned list of Python libraries
sections.what: Lists every library the app uses with exact versions, grouped by purpose: core settings, database, AI services, language and text tools, news feeds and web fetching, geography, currency, data handling, the dashboard, utilities, and development tools.
sections.why: Likely reason: fixing versions prevents a new library release from breaking the app unexpectedly.
sections.watch_out: Old pinned AI library versions may not match how the code calls them, so changing one version can break the code that uses it.

summary: A pinned list of Python libraries the app needs, each with an exact version number.
purpose: Tells the package installer exactly which libraries and versions to install.
why: Exact versions mean the app behaves the same on each computer and over time.
how: The package installer reads each line and installs that exact version. Comment lines explain optional packages such as the PostgreSQL driver.
inputs: Nothing at runtime. The setup script reads this file during installation.
outputs: An installed set of libraries in the virtual environment.
risks: Some versions are old, such as openai 1.6.1, anthropic 0.8.1, and lxml 4.9.3. The code may use call styles that these versions do not provide. Development tools such as pytest and black are installed with the app. Upgrading one library can break others that depend on it.
debug: If an import error appears after installation, check the version of the named library in this file. If installation fails, check that the Python version is supported and that the build tools for lxml are available.
